findings.text: follow-on: _misfiled_review_candidates reads review._store_index's private entry shape and hard-codes entry["path"]; if that internal shape changes the comprehension yields no candidates and the memo key silently loses the misfiled identities it was added to carry, serving a stale verdict again with no test failing, because the two tests exercise the key through the lookup's own path rather than the index's contract.

follow-on: the fixture hand-writes the misfiled record text and places it directly in the store, so the coupling between how a real review worker files a record under another run id (store_review / the review store's own writer) and how the key enumerates it is not exercised; a change to the filing path could leave these cases green while the enumeration stopped matching.

item_verdicts.diff: read a7e051acc against 9b66ff8a commit by commit; c714ca9cc adds _misfiled_review_candidates and the own-record-gated extension in _review_input_identities plus the new test file, and a7e051acc narrows the in-place case to compare the fields the rewrite moves; no other path changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for tests/test_memo_keys_a_misfiled_record.py to rewrite a misfiled record in place between two classifications and assert the second reads the rewritten verdict, failing at base, with existing memo-reaching tests still green and ruff adding nothing; all hold and I reproduced them independently (head 97 passed, base 1 failed/96, mutant 1 failed).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the classification memo sees a misfiled review record rewritten in place; recovery.py:_review_input_identities now adds the per-file identity of the indexed review-store candidates reachable under another run id whenever the run has none of its own, so the memo key moves on an in-place rewrite; verified by the passing case.
item_verdicts.manifest: read against the tree; status complete, commits c714ca9cc and a7e051acc, baseline_suite 1 failed/96 passed at 9b66ff8a EXIT=1, after_suite 97 passed at a7e051acc EXIT=0, negative control 1 failed EXIT=1; the ruff claim (recovery.py 12 both arms) and the format claim reconcile with my own counts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_memo_keys_a_misfiled_record.py and the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/the-obligations-hook-reads-a-snapshot/memo-keys-a-misfiled-record.html; git diff --stat 9b66ff8a..a7e051acc touches exactly those three, all inside the grant, and the reviewed worktree is clean at a7e051acc.

justifications.durability: the guard is load-bearing and pinned: I removed the two-line key extension and the in-place-rewrite case reds (1 failed/1 passed, EXIT=1) while the unchanged-record case stays green, and a second test pins that an unchanged misfiled record still costs no stream re-read, so the fix does not defeat the memo it keys. The key shares the lookup's enumeration through review._store_index, so the two cannot select different files in membership. Cut because the fixture hand-writes the misfiled record and builds the store directly rather than driving the real reviewer/store_review path, so how a genuinely misfiled record is produced and then enumerated is untested; and _misfiled_review_candidates depends on review._store_index's private entry schema (the "path" key), which no test would fail if it drifted.
justifications.evidence: the done-write's measures are all present and I reproduced them independently in a scratch extraction of 9b66ff8a and a7e051acc under $TMPDIR: head full arm (16 related files) 97 passed EXIT=0; base arm with the new test overlaid 1 failed/96 passed EXIT=1, the only id test_memo_keys_a_misfiled_record.py::test_a_misfiled_record_rewritten_in_place_reclassifies failing with assert 'promotable' == 'scoring'; my own mutation removing the two-line key extension reds the same case (1 failed/1 passed, EXIT=1); ruff check over recovery.py is 12 concise findings in both arms and ruff format --diff is 44 changed lines in both arms, so the change adds no finding and no reformat; the done-when's fragment is recorded. Cut because the base arm's method — the new test file overlaid into the base extraction, without which the base arm could not run the case — is not stated in the manifest, so a reader must infer the overlay from the failure id.
justifications.fit: the diff mirrors the module's idioms — the review_module. prefix, the _file_identity/_directory_identity readers, contextlib.suppress around the glob, the Mapping guard, and descriptive names with no plan, ticket or author reference; the test module docstring (sic) states the mechanism rather than the task. Cut because _misfiled_review_candidates reaches into review._store_index's private return shape and hard-codes the "path" key, so the docstring's "the two cannot drift" rests on that private coupling rather than on a shared named helper.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node goal is that the classification memo sees a misfiled review record rewritten in place; recovery.py _misfiled_review_candidates (6962-6978) reads the same review._store_index(directory).get(run_id) set that stored_record's _record_filed_elsewhere searches, and _review_input_identities (6990-7013) adds each such file's _file_identity only when _own_review_record_exists is false, so a run with its own record keys exactly as before; I reproduced the behaviour end to end (rewrite in place: before promotable, after scoring, equals the memo-free arm). Cut one point because the key enumerates every indexed candidate naming the run without the head filter the lookup applies, and a cached index keyed on the directory's stat identity does not move when a file's content is rewritten in place, so the key is a conservative superset of what the lookup can return rather than the exact set the lookup returns.
justifications.scope_discipline: two commits (c714ca9cc code+tests, a7e051acc test refinement) touch exactly reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_memo_keys_a_misfiled_record.py and the granted evidence fragment; git status is clean at a7e051acc and the plan, project index and peer paths are untouched; ruff adds nothing over the base. The node changes product source, so by the landing contract it is not small and the evidence fragment is required by its done-when rather than optional prose. Cut one point because the new test file is 227 lines of hand-rolled fixture around a roughly twenty-line change where existing review-store helpers could have been reused.
